title: Juicy Crispy Algerian Lamb Bowl
description: A mustardy, crispy lamb bowl with massaman paste, pressure-cooked to tender perfection and served in a lacquerware bowl for a keto-friendly, indulgent Algerian feast.
instructions: Trim excess fat from the lamb shoulder and cut the meat into bite-sized cubes.
Seal the pressure cooker and add the olive oil, then sear the lamb cubes until browned on all sides.
Stir in the massaman curry paste, Dijon mustard, ground cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper until the meat is evenly coated.
Pour in the coconut milk, water, tamarind paste, and fish sauce, then stir to combine.
Secure the pressure cooker lid, set to high pressure for 12 minutes, and then allow a natural release for 10 minutes.
Open the cooker, remove the lid, and bring the mixture to a gentle boil while stirring to thicken the sauce and crisp the meat edges.
Transfer the lamb and sauce into a lacquerware bowl, and serve immediately.
